## Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks
Swiss and Italian cybersecurity agencies have issued warnings about automated attacks run by AI agents. The targets of concern are organizations in the critical infrastructure sector.

Source: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/italy-and-switzerland-warn-of-autonomous-ai-driven-cyberattacks/)

## Mitel MiCollab zero-days exploited in suspected AI-assisted attacks
Accenture says attackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel published its advisory. It suspects AI helped the attackers, and the activity looks like an extortion campaign.

Source: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/mitel-micollab-zero-days-exploited-in-suspected-ai-assisted-attacks/)
